Title: [LSJ] I'm sure this has been asked a hundred times ...

Messages.Author: Myron Mychal
Messages.Body:
... but do multiple Anarch Revolts stack (i.e. do I lose 2 pool during
Untap if there are 2 Anarch revolts in play?)? This has been a
constant source of aggravation in our gaming group and the White Wolf
website doesn't list any clarifications or rulings for this aspect of
Anarch Revolt. It's the age-old Army of Rats/Anarch Revolt question
though the text on Army of Rats at least clarifies that its effects
are not cumulative.

Thanks in advance

Myron Mychal

Messages.Author: GreySeer
Messages.Body:
"Myron Mychal" <Myr...@badgermeter.com> wrote in message
news:6957a175.02062...@posting.google.com...


All cards stack by default without text specifically stating otherwise. Army
of Rats, was not clarified but rather errataed to prevent it from being
stackable.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Correct.

All effects stack by default, so no clarification on the Anarch Revolt
(which follows the default) is necessary.
